hints.title: Sliding Window Invariant
hints.text: Maintain a window [left, right] such that the difference between max element and min element does not exceed limit.

hints.title: Two Monotonic Deques
hints.text: Maintain one decreasing deque for window maximums and one increasing deque for window minimums.

hints.title: Shrink Left Boundary
hints.text: When max_val - min_val > limit, increment left boundary and remove outdated elements from the front of both deques.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-evaluating min and max for all subarrays takes cubic O(N^3) or quadratic O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Two monotonic deques maintain window extrema in amortized O(1) per step.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate utilizes two monotonic deques to support dynamic window resizing in linear time.
